primary_metric.name: Strict Macro-Group Success Rate
primary_metric.unresolved_rule: UNRESOLVED cases are excluded from a group denominator and reported separately; if a group has no resolved cases, its rate and the headline metric are UNRESOLVED.

secondary_metric.name: Strict Case-Micro Success Rate
secondary_metric.unresolved_rule: UNRESOLVED strict cases are excluded from the denominator and reported separately; if no strict case is resolved, the metric is UNRESOLVED.

complete_pair_diagnostic.name: Strict Complete-Pair Conjunctive Rate
complete_pair_diagnostic.pair_success_rule: a pair passes only when both member cases are PASS
complete_pair_diagnostic.unresolved_rule: A pair containing any UNRESOLVED case is UNRESOLVED, excluded from the denominator, and reported separately.

controlled_diagnostics.reporting_rule: Report individually and separately; never include in primary macro, strict case-micro, or strict complete-pair metrics.

evidence_boundary: This policy reproduces static aggregation only and is not a scorer, release, freeze, holdout, preregistration, live-run authorization, or model-performance claim.
